$comment: Per-package settings for apps/api. IMPORTANT: project settings load ONLY from the directory you start Claude in — they are not inherited from the repo root the way CLAUDE.md files are. Everything here applies to sessions started in apps/api/ and is inert when you start at the repo root. Keep it self-contained.

env.$comment: Package-scoped tuning. The API suite is slow, so the Stop gate only warns here.

worktree.$comment: A worktree for API work checks out three directories, not the whole monorepo. Include .claude or the repo config is missing inside the worktree.

$comment_plugins: Package-scoped plugins. A TypeScript language server earns its cost in this package and is pointless in a docs-only session. Comments cannot live inside a JSON array, so this note sits beside it.
$comment_hooks: Package-scoped hooks fire only for sessions started in apps/api/. For enforcement that must also work from the repo root, use .claude/hooks/section-dispatch.sh at the root instead.
